315d468.summary: Queues every card animation of an ability on the battle manager, after skipping those that need a free minion slot that is not available. Called when an ability fires; it only schedules visuals (AddCardAnim) and does not change game state itself.

Animation 0x10 or second-spot end: needs friendly slot 2 free
Animation 0x11 or third-spot end: needs friendly slot 3 free
